class RealWorldUseCases:
    """
    Real-world implementations of latency patterns
    """
    
    def __init__(self, spark: SparkSession):
        self.spark = spark
    
    def fraud_detection_system(self):
        """
        Use Case: Real-time fraud detection
        Pattern: Low-Latency + Variable Latency
        """
        logger.info("Starting Fraud Detection System")
        
        # Simulate transaction stream
        transactions = (self.spark
            .readStream
            .format("rate")
            .option("rowsPerSecond", 5000)
            .load()
            .withColumn("transaction_id", expr("uuid()"))
            .withColumn("user_id", expr("concat('user_', cast(value % 10000 as string))"))
            .withColumn("merchant_id", expr("concat('merchant_', cast(value % 1000 as string))"))
            .withColumn("amount", expr("rand() * 5000"))
            .withColumn("card_number", expr("concat('****', cast(value % 10000 as string))"))
            .withColumn("location", expr("concat('loc_', cast(value % 100 as string))"))
            .withColumn("timestamp", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        # Calculate fraud risk score
        risk_scored = (transactions
            .withColumn("hour", hour("timestamp"))
            .withColumn(
                "risk_score",
                when(col("amount") > 3000, lit(50))
                .when(col("amount") > 1000, lit(30))
                .otherwise(lit(10)) +
                when(col("hour").between(0, 5), lit(20))  # Night transactions
                .otherwise(lit(0))
            )
            .withColumn(
                "risk_level",
                when(col("risk_score") >= 60, lit("HIGH"))
                .when(col("risk_score") >= 40, lit("MEDIUM"))
                .otherwise(lit("LOW"))
            )
        )
        
        # High-risk transactions - immediate processing
        high_risk = (risk_scored
            .filter(col("risk_level") == "HIGH")
            .withColumn("alert_time", current_timestamp())
            .select(
                "transaction_id",
                "user_id",
                "amount",
                "merchant_id",
                "risk_score",
                "timestamp",
                "alert_time"
            )
        )
        
        # Medium/Low risk - batch analytics
        analytics = (risk_scored
            .filter(col("risk_level").isin(["MEDIUM", "LOW"]))
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "5 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "1 minute"),
                "merchant_id",
                "risk_level"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("transaction_count"),
                sum("amount").alias("total_amount"),
                avg("risk_score").alias("avg_risk_score")
            )
        )
        
        # Start queries
        high_risk_query = (high_risk
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("fraud_alerts")
            .trigger(processingTime="2 seconds")  # Low latency for alerts
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/fraud_alerts")
            .start()
        )
        
        analytics_query = (analytics
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("fraud_analytics")
            .trigger(processingTime="30 seconds")  # Batch for analytics
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/fraud_analytics")
            .start()
        )
        
        return [high_risk_query, analytics_query]
    
    def iot_sensor_monitoring(self):
        """
        Use Case: IoT sensor monitoring and alerting
        Pattern: Predictable Latency + Balanced
        """
        logger.info("Starting IoT Sensor Monitoring System")
        
        # Simulate IoT sensor data
        sensor_data = (self.spark
            .readStream
            .format("rate")
            .option("rowsPerSecond", 10000)
            .load()
            .withColumn("sensor_id", expr("concat('sensor_', cast(value % 500 as string))"))
            .withColumn("device_type", 
                       expr("array('temperature', 'pressure', 'humidity', 'vibration')[cast(rand() * 4 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("reading", expr("rand() * 100"))
            .withColumn("latitude", expr("rand() * 180 - 90"))
            .withColumn("longitude", expr("rand() * 360 - 180"))
            .withColumn("timestamp", current_timestamp())
            .withColumn("battery_level", expr("rand() * 100"))
        )
        
        # Define thresholds
        anomaly_detected = (sensor_data
            .withColumn(
                "is_anomaly",
                when(
                    (col("device_type") == "temperature") & (col("reading") > 80),
                    lit(True)
                ).when(
                    (col("device_type") == "pressure") & (col("reading") > 90),
                    lit(True)
                ).when(
                    (col("device_type") == "vibration") & (col("reading") > 75),
                    lit(True)
                ).when(
                    col("battery_level") < 10,
                    lit(True)
                ).otherwise(lit(False))
            )
            .withColumn(
                "severity",
                when(col("battery_level") < 5, lit("CRITICAL"))
                .when(col("reading") > 95, lit("CRITICAL"))
                .when(col("is_anomaly"), lit("WARNING"))
                .otherwise(lit("NORMAL"))
            )
        )
        
        # Immediate alerts for anomalies
        alerts = (anomaly_detected
            .filter(col("is_anomaly") == True)
            .select(
                "sensor_id",
                "device_type",
                "reading",
                "severity",
                "battery_level",
                "latitude",
                "longitude",
                "timestamp"
            )
        )
        
        # Aggregated metrics
        metrics = (sensor_data
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "10 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "5 minutes"),
                "device_type"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("reading_count"),
                avg("reading").alias("avg_reading"),
                min("reading").alias("min_reading"),
                max("reading").alias("max_reading"),
                stddev("reading").alias("stddev_reading"),
                avg("battery_level").alias("avg_battery")
            )
            .withColumn("processing_time", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        # Start queries
        alert_query = (alerts
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("iot_alerts")
            .trigger(processingTime="5 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/iot_alerts")
            .start()
        )
        
        metrics_query = (metrics
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("iot_metrics")
            .trigger(processingTime="30 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/iot_metrics")
            .start()
        )
        
        return [alert_query, metrics_query]
    
    def clickstream_analytics(self):
        """
        Use Case: Real-time clickstream analytics
        Pattern: High-Throughput + Balanced
        """
        logger.info("Starting Clickstream Analytics System")
        
        # Simulate clickstream data
        clickstream = (self.spark
            .readStream
            .format("rate")
            .option("rowsPerSecond", 20000)
            .load()
            .withColumn("session_id", expr("uuid()"))
            .withColumn("user_id", expr("concat('user_', cast(value % 50000 as string))"))
            .withColumn("page_url", 
                       expr("concat('/page/', cast(value % 100 as string))"))
            .withColumn("event_type",
                       expr("array('pageview', 'click', 'scroll', 'hover')[cast(rand() * 4 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("duration_seconds", expr("cast(rand() * 300 as int)"))
            .withColumn("referrer", expr("concat('ref_', cast(value % 20 as string))"))
            .withColumn("device_type",
                       expr("array('mobile', 'desktop', 'tablet')[cast(rand() * 3 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("timestamp", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        # Real-time page popularity
        page_popularity = (clickstream
            .filter(col("event_type") == "pageview")
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "2 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "1 minute"),
                "page_url"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("view_count"),
                countDistinct("user_id").alias("unique_visitors")
            )
            .withColumn("popularity_score", col("view_count") * 0.7 + col("unique_visitors") * 0.3)
            .orderBy(col("popularity_score").desc())
        )
        
        # User engagement metrics
        engagement = (clickstream
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "10 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "5 minutes"),
                "user_id",
                "device_type"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("total_events"),
                sum("duration_seconds").alias("total_duration"),
                countDistinct("page_url").alias("pages_visited"),
                collect_set("event_type").alias("event_types")
            )
            .withColumn("avg_duration", col("total_duration") / col("total_events"))
            .withColumn(
                "engagement_level",
                when(col("total_events") > 50, lit("HIGH"))
                .when(col("total_events") > 20, lit("MEDIUM"))
                .otherwise(lit("LOW"))
            )
        )
        
        # Device analytics
        device_stats = (clickstream
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "15 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "10 minutes"),
                "device_type",
                "event_type"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("event_count"),
                countDistinct("user_id").alias("unique_users"),
                avg("duration_seconds").alias("avg_duration")
            )
        )
        
        # Start queries
        popularity_query = (page_popularity
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("page_popularity")
            .trigger(processingTime="10 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/page_popularity")
            .start()
        )
        
        engagement_query = (engagement
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("user_engagement")
            .trigger(processingTime="30 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/user_engagement")
            .start()
        )
        
        device_query = (device_stats
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("device_analytics")
            .trigger(processingTime="60 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/device_analytics")
            .start()
        )
        
        return [popularity_query, engagement_query, device_query]
    
    def log_aggregation_system(self):
        """
        Use Case: Centralized log aggregation and analysis
        Pattern: High-Throughput
        """
        
```python
        logger.info("Starting Log Aggregation System")
        
        # Simulate log data from multiple sources
        logs = (self.spark
            .readStream
            .format("rate")
            .option("rowsPerSecond", 50000)  # High volume
            .load()
            .withColumn("log_id", expr("uuid()"))
            .withColumn("application", 
                       expr("array('web-app', 'api-service', 'database', 'cache', 'queue')[cast(rand() * 5 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("severity",
                       expr("array('DEBUG', 'INFO', 'WARN', 'ERROR', 'FATAL')[cast(rand() * 5 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("host", expr("concat('host-', cast(value % 100 as string))"))
            .withColumn("message", expr("concat('Log message ', cast(value as string))"))
            .withColumn("response_time_ms", expr("cast(rand() * 5000 as int)"))
            .withColumn("status_code", 
                       expr("array(200, 201, 400, 404, 500, 503)[cast(rand() * 6 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("timestamp", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        # Error rate monitoring
        error_stats = (logs
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "5 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "1 minute"),
                "application",
                "severity"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("log_count"),
                countDistinct("host").alias("affected_hosts")
            )
            .withColumn(
                "is_critical",
                (col("severity").isin(["ERROR", "FATAL"])) & (col("log_count") > 100)
            )
        )
        
        # Performance metrics
        performance = (logs
            .filter(col("response_time_ms").isNotNull())
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "10 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "5 minutes"),
                "application"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("request_count"),
                avg("response_time_ms").alias("avg_response_time"),
                expr("percentile_approx(response_time_ms, 0.95)").alias("p95_response_time"),
                expr("percentile_approx(response_time_ms, 0.99)").alias("p99_response_time"),
                min("response_time_ms").alias("min_response_time"),
                max("response_time_ms").alias("max_response_time")
            )
            .withColumn(
                "performance_status",
                when(col("p95_response_time") > 3000, lit("DEGRADED"))
                .when(col("p95_response_time") > 1000, lit("SLOW"))
                .otherwise(lit("HEALTHY"))
            )
        )
        
        # Status code distribution
        status_distribution = (logs
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "15 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "10 minutes"),
                "application",
                "status_code"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("count")
            )
            .withColumn("window_start", col("window.start"))
            .withColumn("window_end", col("window.end"))
            .drop("window")
        )
        
        # Start queries with high-throughput configuration
        error_query = (error_stats
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("error_monitoring")
            .trigger(processingTime="30 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/log_errors")
            .start()
        )
        
        performance_query = (performance
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("performance_metrics")
            .trigger(processingTime="60 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/log_performance")
            .start()
        )
        
        status_query = (status_distribution
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("status_distribution")
            .trigger(processingTime="120 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/log_status")
            .start()
        )
        
        return [error_query, performance_query, status_query]

# ============================================================================

class LatencyMonitor:
    """
    Monitor streaming latency and generate alerts
    """
    
    def __init__(self, query: StreamingQuery, pattern_name: str):
        self.query = query
        self.pattern_name = pattern_name
        self.latency_history = []
        self.alert_threshold_ms = 5000  # 5 seconds
        
    def monitor(self, duration_seconds: int = 60):
        """
        Monitor query latency over specified duration
        """
        logger.info(f"Starting latency monitoring for {self.pattern_name}")
        
        start_time = time.time()
        
        while (time.time() - start_time) < duration_seconds:
            if self.query.isActive:
                progress = self.query.lastProgress
                
                if progress:
                    processing_time = progress.get("durationMs", {}).get("triggerExecution", 0)
                    
                    self.latency_history.append({
                        'timestamp': datetime.now(),
                        'processing_time_ms': processing_time,
                        'batch_id': progress.get("batchId", 0)
                    })
                    
                    # Check for alerts
                    if processing_time > self.alert_threshold_ms:
                        self._generate_alert(processing_time)
            
            time.sleep(5)
        
        self._generate_report()
    
    def _generate_alert(self, latency_ms: float):
        """
        Generate alert for high latency
        """
        logger.warning(f"""
        ⚠️  HIGH LATENCY ALERT ⚠️
        Pattern: {self.pattern_name}
        Current Latency: {latency_ms:.2f} ms
        Threshold: {self.alert_threshold_ms} ms
        Timestamp: {datetime.now()}
        """)
    
    def _generate_report(self):
        """
        Generate latency monitoring report
        """
        if not self.latency_history:
            logger.warning("No latency data collected")
            return
        
        latencies = [entry['processing_time_ms'] for entry in self.latency_history]
        
        avg_latency = sum(latencies) / len(latencies)
        min_latency = min(latencies)
        max_latency = max(latencies)
        
        # Calculate percentiles
        sorted_latencies = sorted(latencies)
        p50 = sorted_latencies[len(sorted_latencies) // 2]
        p95_idx = int(len(sorted_latencies) * 0.95)
        p95 = sorted_latencies[p95_idx] if p95_idx < len(sorted_latencies) else max_latency
        p99_idx = int(len(sorted_latencies) * 0.99)
        p99 = sorted_latencies[p99_idx] if p99_idx < len(sorted_latencies) else max_latency
        
        logger.info(f"""
        ========================================
        LATENCY MONITORING REPORT
        ========================================
        Pattern: {self.pattern_name}
        Duration: {len(self.latency_history)} samples
        
        Latency Statistics (ms):
        - Average: {avg_latency:.2f}
        - Minimum: {min_latency:.2f}
        - Maximum: {max_latency:.2f}
        - P50 (Median): {p50:.2f}
        - P95: {p95:.2f}
        - P99: {p99:.2f}
        
        Violations: {sum(1 for l in latencies if l > self.alert_threshold_ms)}
        ========================================
        """)

class StreamingQueryManager:
    """
    Manage multiple streaming queries with different latency patterns
    """
    
    def __init__(self, spark: SparkSession):
        self.spark = spark
        self.queries = {}
        
    def add_query(self, name: str, query: StreamingQuery):
        """
        Add a query to the manager
        """
        self.queries[name] = query
        logger.info(f"Added query: {name}")
    
    def stop_query(self, name: str):
        """
        Stop a specific query
        """
        if name in self.queries:
            self.queries[name].stop()
            logger.info(f"Stopped query: {name}")
            del self.queries[name]
    
    def stop_all(self):
        """
        Stop all managed queries
        """
        logger.info("Stopping all queries...")
        for name, query in list(self.queries.items()):
            try:
                query.stop()
                logger.info(f"Stopped query: {name}")
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Error stopping query {name}: {str(e)}")
        self.queries.clear()
    
    def get_all_metrics(self) -> Dict[str, Dict[str, Any]]:
        """
        Get metrics for all active queries
        """
        metrics = {}
        for name, query in self.queries.items():
            if query.isActive:
                metrics[name] = StreamingMetricsCollector.collect_query_metrics(query)
        return metrics
    
    def print_status(self):
        """
        Print status of all queries
        """
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("STREAMING QUERIES STATUS")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        for name, query in self.queries.items():
            status = "ACTIVE" if query.isActive else "STOPPED"
            logger.info(f"{name}: {status}")
            
            if query.isActive:
                metrics = StreamingMetricsCollector.collect_query_metrics(query)
                if metrics:
                    logger.info(f"  Batch ID: {metrics.get('batch_id', 'N/A')}")
                    logger.info(f"  Input Rate: {metrics.get('input_rate', 0):.2f} rows/sec")
                    logger.info(f"  Processing Rate: {metrics.get('processing_rate', 0):.2f} rows/sec")
        
        logger.info("=" * 80)


class LatencyPatternSelector:
    """
    Intelligent pattern selector based on requirements
    """
    
    @staticmethod
    def recommend_pattern(
        required_latency_ms: float,
        data_rate_per_sec: float,
        complexity: str = "medium",
        sla_required: bool = False
    ) -> str:
        """
        Recommend a latency pattern based on requirements
        
        Args:
            required_latency_ms: Required end-to-end latency in milliseconds
            data_rate_per_sec: Expected data rate (records per second)
            complexity: Processing complexity (low, medium, high)
            sla_required: Whether SLA guarantees are needed
            
        Returns:
            Recommended pattern name
        """
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("LATENCY PATTERN RECOMMENDATION")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        logger.info(f"Requirements:")
        logger.info(f"  Required Latency: {required_latency_ms} ms")
        logger.info(f"  Data Rate: {data_rate_per_sec} records/sec")
        logger.info(f"  Complexity: {complexity}")
        logger.info(f"  SLA Required: {sla_required}")
        logger.info("-" * 80)
        
        # Decision logic
        if sla_required:
            recommendation = "predictable"
            reason = "SLA requirements need predictable latency"
        elif required_latency_ms < 2000:
            recommendation = "low_latency"
            reason = "Sub-2-second latency requires low-latency pattern"
        elif data_rate_per_sec > 10000 and required_latency_ms > 30000:
            recommendation = "high_throughput"
            reason = "High data rate with relaxed latency favors throughput optimization"
        elif required_latency_ms < 5000 and data_rate_per_sec > 5000:
            recommendation = "variable"
            reason = "Mixed requirements benefit from adaptive processing"
        else:
            recommendation = "balanced"
            reason = "Moderate requirements suit balanced approach"
        
        logger.info(f"Recommendation: {recommendation.upper()}")
        logger.info(f"Reason: {reason}")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        return recommendation
    
    @staticmethod
    def calculate_resource_requirements(
        pattern: str,
        data_rate_per_sec: float
    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Calculate estimated resource requirements
        """
        # Base resource multipliers for each pattern
        multipliers = {
            "low_latency": {"cpu": 1.5, "memory": 1.2, "network": 1.3},
            "high_throughput": {"cpu": 1.0, "memory": 1.5, "network": 1.0},
            "balanced": {"cpu": 1.0, "memory": 1.0, "network": 1.0},
            "predictable": {"cpu": 1.2, "memory": 1.1, "network": 1.1},
            "variable": {"cpu": 1.3, "memory": 1.2, "network": 1.2}
        }
        
        base_cpu_cores = max(4, int(data_rate_per_sec / 1000))
        base_memory_gb = max(8, int(data_rate_per_sec / 500))
        
        mult = multipliers.get(pattern, multipliers["balanced"])
        
        return {
            "pattern": pattern,
            "recommended_cpu_cores": int(base_cpu_cores * mult["cpu"]),
            "recommended_memory_gb": int(base_memory_gb * mult["memory"]),
            "recommended_executors": max(2, int(base_cpu_cores / 4)),
            "network_bandwidth_multiplier": mult["network"]
        }

        - Less adaptive to load changes
        - May under-utilize resources
    
    ================================================================================
    
    PATTERN 5: VARIABLE LATENCY
    ----------------------------
    Description:
        Adapts latency based on data characteristics, priority, and system load.
        Provides flexible processing for heterogeneous workloads.
    
    Characteristics:
        - Dynamic batch intervals
        - Priority-based processing
        - Load-based adjustments
        - Multiple processing paths
        - Resource optimization
    
    Best For:
        - Multi-tenant systems
        - Priority-based processing
        - Mixed workloads
        - Cost optimization
        - Adaptive applications
    
    Configuration:
        trigger_interval: dynamic (based on priority)
        watermark: "5 minutes"
        shuffle_partitions: 150
        backpressure: enabled
    
    Trade-offs:
        + Flexible and adaptive
        + Optimizes for priority
        + Cost effective
        - More complex to manage
        - Variable performance
    
    ================================================================================
    
    SELECTION GUIDE
    ---------------
    
    Choose LOW-LATENCY when:
        ✓ Latency < 5 seconds required
        ✓ Real-time response critical
        ✓ Cost is secondary concern
    
    Choose HIGH-THROUGHPUT when:
        ✓ Processing millions of records
        ✓ Latency > 30 seconds acceptable
        ✓ Cost efficiency important
    
    Choose BALANCED when:
        ✓ General-purpose streaming
        ✓ Latency 10-30 seconds acceptable
        ✓ Standard business requirements
    
    Choose PREDICTABLE when:
        ✓ SLA guarantees required
        ✓ Consistent performance needed
        ✓ Regulated environment
    
    Choose VARIABLE when:
        ✓ Multiple priority levels
        ✓ Mixed workload characteristics
        ✓ Dynamic resource allocation
    
    ================================================================================
    """
    
    print(documentation)


# ============================================================================
# TESTING UTILITIES
# ============================================================================

class PatternTester:
    """
    Test utilities for validating latency patterns
    """
    
    @staticmethod
    def validate_latency_requirement(
```python
        query: StreamingQuery,
        max_latency_ms: float,
        duration_seconds: int = 60
    ) -> bool:
        """
        Validate if a query meets latency requirements
        
        Args:
            query: Streaming query to validate
            max_latency_ms: Maximum acceptable latency in milliseconds
            duration_seconds: Duration to test
            
        Returns:
            True if requirements are met, False otherwise
        """
        logger.info(f"Validating latency requirement: {max_latency_ms} ms")
        
        violations = 0
        total_samples = 0
        start_time = time.time()
        
        while (time.time() - start_time) < duration_seconds:
            if query.isActive:
                progress = query.lastProgress
                
                if progress:
                    processing_time = progress.get("durationMs", {}).get("triggerExecution", 0)
                    total_samples += 1
                    
                    if processing_time > max_latency_ms:
                        violations += 1
                        logger.warning(f"Latency violation: {processing_time} ms > {max_latency_ms} ms")
            
            time.sleep(5)
        
        violation_rate = (violations / total_samples * 100) if total_samples > 0 else 0
        passed = violation_rate < 5  # Allow 5% violation rate
        
        logger.info(f"""
        Latency Validation Results:
        ---------------------------
        Total Samples: {total_samples}
        Violations: {violations}
        Violation Rate: {violation_rate:.2f}%
        Status: {'PASSED' if passed else 'FAILED'}
        """)
        
        return passed
    
    @staticmethod
    def stress_test_pattern(
        spark: SparkSession,
        processor_class,
        rates: list = [1000, 5000, 10000, 20000]
    ):
        """
        Stress test a pattern with increasing data rates
        
        Args:
            spark: SparkSession
            processor_class: Processor class to test
            rates: List of data rates to test
        """
        logger.info(f"Starting stress test for {processor_class.__name__}")
        
        results = []
        
        for rate in rates:
            logger.info(f"\nTesting with rate: {rate} records/sec")
            
            try:
                processor = processor_class(spark)
                query = processor.process_stream()
                
                # Run for 30 seconds
                time.sleep(30)
                
                # Collect metrics
                metrics = StreamingMetricsCollector.collect_query_metrics(query)
                
                if metrics:
                    results.append({
                        'rate': rate,
                        'processing_time_ms': metrics.get('processing_time_ms', 0),
                        'input_rate': metrics.get('input_rate', 0),
                        'processing_rate': metrics.get('processing_rate', 0),
                        'status': 'SUCCESS'
                    })
                else:
                    results.append({
                        'rate': rate,
                        'status': 'NO_METRICS'
                    })
                
                query.stop()
                time.sleep(10)  # Cool down
                
            except Exception as e:
                logger.error(f"Failed at rate {rate}: {str(e)}")
                results.append({
                    'rate': rate,
                    'status': 'FAILED',
                    'error': str(e)
                })
        
        # Print results
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("STRESS TEST RESULTS")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        for result in results:
            logger.info(f"\nRate: {result['rate']} records/sec")
            logger.info(f"Status: {result['status']}")
            if result['status'] == 'SUCCESS':
                logger.info(f"Processing Time: {result['processing_time_ms']} ms")
                logger.info(f"Input Rate: {result['input_rate']:.2f} records/sec")
                logger.info(f"Processing Rate: {result['processing_rate']:.2f} records/sec")
        
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        return results

class AdvancedMetricsCollector:
    """
    Advanced metrics collection and analysis
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        self.metrics_history = []
        
    def collect_detailed_metrics(self, query: StreamingQuery) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Collect detailed metrics from streaming query
        """
        if not query.isActive:
            return {}
        
        progress = query.lastProgress
        
        if not progress:
            return {}
        
        detailed_metrics = {
            'timestamp': datetime.now().isoformat(),
            'query_name': query.name,
            'batch_id': progress.get('batchId', 0),
            
            # Input metrics
            'num_input_rows': progress.get('numInputRows', 0),
            'input_rows_per_second': progress.get('inputRowsPerSecond', 0),
            
            # Processing metrics
            'processed_rows_per_second': progress.get('processedRowsPerSecond', 0),
            'batch_duration_ms': progress.get('batchDuration', 0),
            
            # Duration breakdown
            'durations': {
                'add_batch': progress.get('durationMs', {}).get('addBatch', 0),
                'get_batch': progress.get('durationMs', {}).get('getBatch', 0),
                'query_planning': progress.get('durationMs', {}).get('queryPlanning', 0),
                'trigger_execution': progress.get('durationMs', {}).get('triggerExecution', 0),
                'wal_commit': progress.get('durationMs', {}).get('walCommit', 0)
            },
            
            # State metrics
            'state_operators': progress.get('stateOperators', []),
            
            # Source metrics
            'sources': progress.get('sources', []),
            
            # Sink metrics
            'sink': progress.get('sink', {})
        }
        
        self.metrics_history.append(detailed_metrics)
        
        return detailed_metrics
    
    def analyze_performance_trends(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Analyze performance trends from collected metrics
        """
        if not self.metrics_history:
            return {}
        
        # Extract time series data
        processing_times = [
            m['durations']['trigger_execution'] 
            for m in self.metrics_history 
            if 'durations' in m
        ]
        
        input_rates = [
            m['input_rows_per_second'] 
            for m in self.metrics_history 
            if 'input_rows_per_second' in m
        ]
        
        processing_rates = [
            m['processed_rows_per_second'] 
            for m in self.metrics_history 
            if 'processed_rows_per_second' in m
        ]
        
        # Calculate trends
        analysis = {
            'total_batches': len(self.metrics_history),
            
            'processing_time': {
                'mean': sum(processing_times) / len(processing_times) if processing_times else 0,
                'min': min(processing_times) if processing_times else 0,
                'max': max(processing_times) if processing_times else 0,
                'trend': self._calculate_trend(processing_times)
            },
            
            'input_rate': {
                'mean': sum(input_rates) / len(input_rates) if input_rates else 0,
                'min': min(input_rates) if input_rates else 0,
                'max': max(input_rates) if input_rates else 0,
                'trend': self._calculate_trend(input_rates)
            },
            
            'processing_rate': {
                'mean': sum(processing_rates) / len(processing_rates) if processing_rates else 0,
                'min': min(processing_rates) if processing_rates else 0,
                'max': max(processing_rates) if processing_rates else 0,
                'trend': self._calculate_trend(processing_rates)
            },
            
            'backlog_trend': self._analyze_backlog(input_rates, processing_rates)
        }
        
        return analysis
    
    @staticmethod
    def _calculate_trend(values: list) -> str:
        """
        Calculate trend direction from values
        """
        if len(values) < 2:
            return "INSUFFICIENT_DATA"
        
        # Simple linear trend
        first_half = sum(values[:len(values)//2]) / (len(values)//2)
        second_half = sum(values[len(values)//2:]) / (len(values) - len(values)//2)
        
        diff_pct = ((second_half - first_half) / first_half * 100) if first_half > 0 else 0
        
        if diff_pct > 10:
            return "INCREASING"
        elif diff_pct < -10:
            return "DECREASING"
        else:
            return "STABLE"
    
    @staticmethod
    def _analyze_backlog(input_rates: list, processing_rates: list) -> str:
        """
        Analyze if backlog is building up
        """
        if not input_rates or not processing_rates:
            return "UNKNOWN"
        
        avg_input = sum(input_rates) / len(input_rates)
        avg_processing = sum(processing_rates) / len(processing_rates)
        
        if avg_input > avg_processing * 1.1:
            return "BUILDING"
        elif avg_input < avg_processing * 0.9:
            return "DECREASING"
        else:
            return "STABLE"
    
    def print_analysis(self):
        """
        Print detailed analysis of collected metrics
        """
        analysis = self.analyze_performance_trends()
        
        if not analysis:
            logger.warning("No metrics to analyze")
            return
        
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("PERFORMANCE TREND ANALYSIS")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        logger.info(f"\nTotal Batches Analyzed: {analysis['total_batches']}")
        
        logger.info("\nProcessing Time (ms):")
        logger.info(f"  Mean: {analysis['processing_time']['mean']:.2f}")
        logger.info(f"  Min: {analysis['processing_time']['min']:.2f}")
        logger.info(f"  Max: {analysis['processing_time']['max']:.2f}")
        logger.info(f"  Trend: {analysis['processing_time']['trend']}")
        
        logger.info("\nInput Rate (records/sec):")
        logger.info(f"  Mean: {analysis['input_rate']['mean']:.2f}")
        logger.info(f"  Min: {analysis['input_rate']['min']:.2f}")
        logger.info(f"  Max: {analysis['input_rate']['max']:.2f}")
        logger.info(f"  Trend: {analysis['input_rate']['trend']}")
        
        logger.info("\nProcessing Rate (records/sec):")
        logger.info(f"  Mean: {analysis['processing_rate']['mean']:.2f}")
        logger.info(f"  Min: {analysis['processing_rate']['min']:.2f}")
        logger.info(f"  Max: {analysis['processing_rate']['max']:.2f}")
        logger.info(f"  Trend: {analysis['processing_rate']['trend']}")
        
        logger.info(f"\nBacklog Status: {analysis['backlog_trend']}")
        
        logger.info("=" * 80)

class ComprehensiveStreamingPipeline:
    """
    Comprehensive example integrating all latency patterns
    """
    
    def __init__(self, spark: SparkSession):
        self.spark = spark
        self.query_manager = StreamingQueryManager(spark)
        self.metrics_collector = AdvancedMetricsCollector()
        
    def run_multi_pattern_pipeline(self):
        """
        Run a complete pipeline using multiple latency patterns
        """
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("COMPREHENSIVE MULTI-PATTERN STREAMING PIPELINE")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        # Create main data stream
        main_stream = (self.spark
            .readStream
            .format("rate")
            .option("rowsPerSecond", 10000)
            .load()
            .withColumn("event_id", expr("uuid()"))
            .withColumn("user_id", expr("concat('user_', cast(value % 1000 as string))"))
            .withColumn("event_type",
                       expr("array('click', 'view', 'purchase', 'error')[cast(rand() * 4 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("value", expr("rand() * 1000"))
            .withColumn("priority",
                       expr("array('low', 'medium', 'high', 'critical')[cast(rand() * 4 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("timestamp", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        # Pattern 1: Low-latency for critical events
        critical_stream = (main_stream
            .filter(col("priority") == "critical")
            .withColumn("alert_time", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        critical_query = (critical_stream
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("critical_events")
            .trigger(processingTime="2 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/multi_critical")
            .start()
        )
        
        self.query_manager.add_query("critical_events", critical_query)
        
        # Pattern 2: Balanced for real-time analytics
        realtime_analytics = (main_stream
            .filter(col("priority").isin(["high", "medium"]))
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "5 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "1 minute"),
                "event_type"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("event_count"),
                avg("value").alias("avg_value")
            )
        )
        
        analytics_query = (realtime_analytics
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("realtime_analytics")
            .trigger(processingTime="15 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/multi_analytics")
            .start()
        )
        
        self.query_manager.add_query("realtime_analytics", analytics_query)
        
        # Pattern 3: High-throughput for batch processing
        batch_processing = (main_stream
            .filter(col("priority") == "low")
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "15 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "10 minutes"),
                "user_id",
                "event_type"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("total_events"),
                sum("value").alias("total_value"),
                collect_list("event_id").alias("event_ids")
            )
        )
        
        batch_query = (batch_processing
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("batch_processing")
            .
```python
            .trigger(processingTime="60 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/multi_batch")
            .start()
        )
        
        self.query_manager.add_query("batch_processing", batch_query)
        
        # Monitor all queries
        logger.info("\nAll queries started. Monitoring for 120 seconds...")
        
        start_time = time.time()
        while (time.time() - start_time) < 120:
            time.sleep(10)
            
            # Collect metrics for all queries
            for name, query in self.query_manager.queries.items():
                metrics = self.metrics_collector.collect_detailed_metrics(query)
                if metrics:
                    logger.info(f"\n{name}: Processing batch {metrics.get('batch_id', 'N/A')}")
            
            # Print status every 30 seconds
            if int(time.time() - start_time) % 30 == 0:
                self.query_manager.print_status()
        
        # Print final analysis
        self.metrics_collector.print_analysis()
        
        # Stop all queries
        self.query_manager.stop_all()
        
        logger.info("\nPipeline completed successfully!")

# TROUBLESHOOTING GUIDE
# ============================================================================

class TroubleshootingGuide:
    """
    Troubleshooting guide for common streaming issues
    """
    
    @staticmethod
    def diagnose_latency_issues(query: StreamingQuery) -> Dict[str, Any]:
        """
        Diagnose latency issues in a streaming query
        """
        if not query.isActive:
            return {"status": "QUERY_NOT_ACTIVE"}
        
        progress = query.lastProgress
        
        if not progress:
            return {"status": "NO_PROGRESS_DATA"}
        
        diagnosis = {
            "status": "ANALYZING",
            "issues": [],
            "recommendations": []
        }
        
        # Check processing time
        trigger_time = progress.get("durationMs", {}).get("triggerExecution", 0)
        
        if trigger_time > 10000:  # > 10 seconds
            diagnosis["issues"].append("High processing time detected")
            diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Consider increasing parallelism")
            diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Optimize transformations")
        
        # Check input vs processing rate
        input_rate = progress.get("inputRowsPerSecond", 0)
        processing_rate = progress.get("processedRowsPerSecond", 0)
        
        if input_rate > processing_rate * 1.2:
            diagnosis["issues"].append("Input rate exceeds processing capacity")
            diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Increase resources")
            diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Optimize query logic")
            diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Consider partitioning data")
        
        # Check for scheduling delays
        durations = progress.get("durationMs", {})
        query_planning = durations.get("queryPlanning", 0)
        
        if query_planning > 1000:
            diagnosis["issues"].append("High query planning time")
            diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Simplify query logic")
            diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Reduce number of transformations")
        
        # Check state store operations
        state_operators = progress.get("stateOperators", [])
        
        for state_op in state_operators:
            num_rows = state_op.get("numRowsTotal", 0)
            memory_used = state_op.get("memoryUsedBytes", 0)
            
            if num_rows > 1000000:
                diagnosis["issues"].append("Large state size detected")
                diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Implement state cleanup")
                diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Use shorter watermarks")
            
            if memory_used > 1073741824:  # > 1GB
                diagnosis["issues"].append("High state memory usage")
                diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Increase executor memory")
                diagnosis["recommendations"].append("Optimize state schema")
        
        diagnosis["status"] = "COMPLETED"
        
        return diagnosis
    
    @staticmethod
    def print_diagnosis(diagnosis: Dict[str, Any]):
        """
        Print diagnosis results
        """
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("LATENCY ISSUE DIAGNOSIS")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        logger.info(f"\nStatus: {diagnosis.get('status', 'UNKNOWN')}")
        
        issues = diagnosis.get("issues", [])
        if issues:
            logger.info("\nIssues Detected:")
            for i, issue in enumerate(issues, 1):
                logger.info(f"  {i}. {issue}")
        else:
            logger.info("\nNo issues detected")
        
        recommendations = diagnosis.get("recommendations", [])
        if recommendations:
            logger.info("\nRecommendations:")
            for i, rec in enumerate(recommendations, 1):
                logger.info(f"  {i}. {rec}")
        
        logger.info("=" * 80)

class CompleteWorkingExamples:
    """
    Complete, ready-to-run examples for each pattern
    """
    
    def __init__(self, spark: SparkSession):
        self.spark = spark
    
    def example_1_fraud_detection_low_latency(self):
        """
        Complete example: Real-time fraud detection using low-latency pattern
        """
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("COMPLETE EXAMPLE 1: Real-time Fraud Detection")
        logger.info("Pattern: Low-Latency")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        # Configure for low latency
        LatencyOptimizer.optimize_spark_config(self.spark, "low_latency")
        
        # Create transaction stream
        transactions = (self.spark
            .readStream
            .format("rate")
            .option("rowsPerSecond", 3000)
            .load()
            .withColumn("transaction_id", expr("uuid()"))
            .withColumn("card_number", expr("concat('****', lpad(cast(value % 10000 as string), 4, '0'))"))
            .withColumn("amount", expr("case when rand() > 0.95 then rand() * 10000 else rand() * 500 end"))
            .withColumn("merchant", expr("concat('merchant_', cast(value % 100 as string))"))
            .withColumn("location", expr("concat('city_', cast(value % 50 as string))"))
            .withColumn("timestamp", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        # Apply fraud detection rules
        fraud_detection = (transactions
            .withColumn("ingestion_time", current_timestamp())
            .withColumn("is_high_amount", col("amount") > 5000)
            .withColumn("hour_of_day", hour("timestamp"))
            .withColumn("is_night_transaction", col("hour_of_day").between(0, 5))
            .withColumn(
                "fraud_score",
                when(col("is_high_amount"), lit(40)).otherwise(lit(0)) +
                when(col("is_night_transaction"), lit(30)).otherwise(lit(0)) +
                (expr("rand() * 30"))
            )
            .withColumn(
                "fraud_risk",
                when(col("fraud_score") >= 70, lit("HIGH"))
                .when(col("fraud_score") >= 40, lit("MEDIUM"))
                .otherwise(lit("LOW"))
            )
            .filter(col("fraud_risk").isin(["HIGH", "MEDIUM"]))
            .withColumn("alert_time", current_timestamp())
            .withColumn(
                "processing_latency_ms",
                (unix_timestamp("alert_time") - unix_timestamp("ingestion_time")) * 1000
            )
            .select(
                "transaction_id",
                "card_number",
                "amount",
                "merchant",
                "location",
                "fraud_score",
                "fraud_risk",
                "timestamp",
                "alert_time",
                "processing_latency_ms"
            )
        )
        
        # Write to console with low latency
        query = (fraud_detection
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .option("truncate", False)
            .option("numRows", 20)
            .trigger(processingTime="2 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/fraud_detection_example")
            .start()
        )
        
        # Monitor
        logger.info("Monitoring fraud detection for 60 seconds...")
        monitor = LatencyMonitor(query, "Fraud Detection")
        monitor.monitor(60)
        
        query.stop()
        logger.info("Fraud detection example completed")
        
        return query
    
    def example_2_clickstream_high_throughput(self):
        """
        Complete example: Clickstream analytics using high-throughput pattern
        """
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("COMPLETE EXAMPLE 2: Clickstream Analytics")
        logger.info("Pattern: High-Throughput")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        # Configure for high throughput
        LatencyOptimizer.optimize_spark_config(self.spark, "high_throughput")
        
        # Create clickstream
        clickstream = (self.spark
            .readStream
            .format("rate")
            .option("rowsPerSecond", 15000)
            .load()
            .withColumn("click_id", expr("uuid()"))
            .withColumn("user_id", expr("concat('user_', cast(value % 10000 as string))"))
            .withColumn("session_id", expr("concat('session_', cast(value % 50000 as string))"))
            .withColumn("page_url", expr("concat('/page/', cast(value % 200 as string))"))
            .withColumn("referrer", expr("concat('ref_', cast(value % 50 as string))"))
            .withColumn("user_agent", 
                       expr("array('Chrome', 'Firefox', 'Safari', 'Edge')[cast(rand() * 4 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("device", 
                       expr("array('mobile', 'desktop', 'tablet')[cast(rand() * 3 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("duration_sec", expr("cast(rand() * 600 as int)"))
            .withColumn("timestamp", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        # Comprehensive analytics
        page_analytics = (clickstream
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "10 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "5 minutes"),
                "page_url",
                "device"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("total_views"),
                countDistinct("user_id").alias("unique_users"),
                countDistinct("session_id").alias("unique_sessions"),
                avg("duration_sec").alias("avg_duration"),
                expr("percentile_approx(duration_sec, 0.5)").alias("median_duration"),
                expr("percentile_approx(duration_sec, 0.95)").alias("p95_duration")
            )
            .withColumn("engagement_score", 
                       col("avg_duration") * 0.5 + col("unique_users") * 0.3 + col("total_views") * 0.2)
            .withColumn("window_start", col("window.start"))
            .withColumn("window_end", col("window.end"))
            .drop("window")
            .orderBy(col("engagement_score").desc())
        )
        
        # Write with high throughput settings
        query = (page_analytics
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .option("truncate", False)
            .option("numRows", 15)
            .trigger(processingTime="60 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/clickstream_example")
            .start()
        )
        
        logger.info("Processing clickstream analytics for 120 seconds...")
        time.sleep(120)
        StreamingMetricsCollector.print_metrics(query)
        
        query.stop()
        logger.info("Clickstream analytics example completed")
        
        return query
    
    def example_3_iot_monitoring_balanced(self):
        """
        Complete example: IoT monitoring using balanced pattern
        """
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("COMPLETE EXAMPLE 3: IoT Sensor Monitoring")
        logger.info("Pattern: Balanced")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        # Configure for balanced processing
        LatencyOptimizer.optimize_spark_config(self.spark, "balanced")
        
        # Create IoT sensor stream
        sensors = (self.spark
            .readStream
            .format("rate")
            .option("rowsPerSecond", 8000)
            .load()
            .withColumn("sensor_id", expr("concat('sensor_', cast(value % 200 as string))"))
            .withColumn("device_type", 
                       expr("array('temperature', 'pressure', 'humidity', 'motion')[cast(rand() * 4 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("reading", expr("50 + rand() * 50"))
            .withColumn("unit", 
                       expr("case when device_type = 'temperature' then 'celsius' " +
                            "when device_type = 'pressure' then 'bar' " +
                            "when device_type = 'humidity' then 'percent' " +
                            "else 'boolean' end"))
            .withColumn("location", expr("concat('zone_', cast(value % 20 as string))"))
            .withColumn("battery_level", expr("rand() * 100"))
            .withColumn("signal_strength", expr("rand() * 100"))
            .withColumn("timestamp", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        # Anomaly detection and aggregation
        sensor_analytics = (sensors
            .withColumn(
                "is_anomaly",
                when(
                    (col("device_type") == "temperature") & (col("reading") > 85),
                    lit(True)
                ).when(
                    (col("device_type") == "pressure") & (col("reading") > 90),
                    lit(True)
                ).when(
                    (col("device_type") == "humidity") & (col("reading") > 95),
                    lit(True)
                ).when(
                    col("battery_level") < 15,
                    lit(True)
                ).otherwise(lit(False))
            )
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "5 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "2 minutes"),
                "device_type",
                "location"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("total_readings"),
                countDistinct("sensor_id").alias("active_sensors"),
                avg("reading").alias("avg_reading"),
                min("reading").alias("min_reading"),
                max("reading").alias("max_reading"),
                stddev("reading").alias("stddev_reading"),
                avg("battery_level").alias("avg_battery"),
                sum(when(col("is_anomaly"), 1).otherwise(0)).alias("anomaly_count")
            )
            .withColumn(
                "health_status",
                when(col("anomaly_count") > 10, lit("CRITICAL"))
                .when(col("anomaly_count") > 5, lit("WARNING"))
                .when(col("avg_battery") < 20, lit("LOW_BATTERY"))
                .otherwise(lit("HEALTHY"))
            )
            .withColumn("window_start", col("window.start"))
            .withColumn("window_end", col("window.end"))
            .drop("window")
        )
        
        # Write with balanced settings
        query = (sensor_analytics
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .option("truncate", False)
            .option("numRows", 20)
            .trigger(processingTime="15 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/iot_monitoring_example")
            .start()
        )
        
        logger.info("Monitoring IoT sensors for 90 seconds...")
        metrics_collector = AdvancedMetricsCollector()
        
        start_time = time.time()
        while (time.time() - start_time) < 90:
            time.sleep(10)
            metrics_collector.collect_detailed_metrics(query)
        
        metrics_collector.print_analysis()
        
        query.stop()
        logger.info("IoT monitoring example completed")
        
        return query
    
    def example_4_financial_predictable(self):
        """
        Complete example: Financial trading using predictable pattern
        """
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("COMPLETE EXAMPLE 4: Financial Trading Monitoring")
        logger.info("Pattern: Predictable Latency")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        # Configure for predictable latency
        LatencyOptimizer.optimize_spark_config(self.spark, "predictable")
        
        # Create trading stream
        trades = (self.spark
            .readStream
            .format("rate")
            .option("rowsPerSecond", 5000)
            .load()
            .withColumn("trade_id", expr("uuid()"))
            .withColumn("symbol", 
                       expr("array('AAPL', 'GOOG
```python
                       expr("array('AAPL', 'GOOGL', 'MSFT', 'AMZN', 'TSLA', 'META', 'NVDA', 'JPM', 'BAC', 'GS')[cast(rand() * 10 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("trade_type", expr("array('BUY', 'SELL')[cast(rand() * 2 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("quantity", expr("cast(rand() * 1000 as int) + 1"))
            .withColumn("price", expr("100 + rand() * 400"))
            .withColumn("trader_id", expr("concat('trader_', cast(value % 500 as string))"))
            .withColumn("exchange", 
                       expr("array('NYSE', 'NASDAQ', 'LSE', 'TSE')[cast(rand() * 4 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("timestamp", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        # Calculate trading metrics with SLA tracking
        trading_metrics = (trades
            .withColumn("trade_value", col("quantity") * col("price"))
            .withColumn("ingestion_time", current_timestamp())
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "1 minute")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "30 seconds", "30 seconds"),  # Fixed windows
                "symbol",
                "exchange"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("trade_count"),
                sum(when(col("trade_type") == "BUY", col("quantity")).otherwise(0)).alias("buy_volume"),
                sum(when(col("trade_type") == "SELL", col("quantity")).otherwise(0)).alias("sell_volume"),
                sum("trade_value").alias("total_value"),
                avg("price").alias("avg_price"),
                min("price").alias("low_price"),
                max("price").alias("high_price"),
                countDistinct("trader_id").alias("unique_traders")
            )
            .withColumn("processing_time", current_timestamp())
            .withColumn("window_start", col("window.start"))
            .withColumn("window_end", col("window.end"))
            .withColumn(
                "processing_latency_sec",
                unix_timestamp("processing_time") - unix_timestamp("window_end")
            )
            .withColumn(
                "sla_met",
                col("processing_latency_sec") <= 30  # 30 second SLA
            )
            .withColumn(
                "net_volume",
                col("buy_volume") - col("sell_volume")
            )
            .withColumn(
                "market_sentiment",
                when(col("net_volume") > 0, lit("BULLISH"))
                .when(col("net_volume") < 0, lit("BEARISH"))
                .otherwise(lit("NEUTRAL"))
            )
            .drop("window")
        )
        
        # Write with predictable latency settings
        query = (trading_metrics
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .option("truncate", False)
            .option("numRows", 25)
            .trigger(processingTime="30 seconds")  # Fixed interval for predictability
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/financial_trading_example")
            .start()
        )
        
        logger.info("Monitoring financial trades for 90 seconds...")
        logger.info("SLA: 30 seconds end-to-end latency")
        
        # Validate SLA compliance
        sla_passed = PatternTester.validate_latency_requirement(query, 30000, 90)
        
        if sla_passed:
            logger.info("✓ SLA COMPLIANCE: PASSED")
        else:
            logger.warning("✗ SLA COMPLIANCE: FAILED")
        
        query.stop()
        logger.info("Financial trading example completed")
        
        return query
    
    def example_5_multi_tenant_variable(self):
        """
        Complete example: Multi-tenant platform using variable latency pattern
        """
        logger.info("\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("COMPLETE EXAMPLE 5: Multi-tenant SaaS Platform")
        logger.info("Pattern: Variable Latency")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        
        # Configure for variable latency
        LatencyOptimizer.optimize_spark_config(self.spark, "variable")
        
        # Create multi-tenant event stream
        events = (self.spark
            .readStream
            .format("rate")
            .option("rowsPerSecond", 10000)
            .load()
            .withColumn("event_id", expr("uuid()"))
            .withColumn("tenant_id", expr("concat('tenant_', cast(value % 20 as string))"))
            .withColumn("user_id", expr("concat('user_', cast(value % 5000 as string))"))
            .withColumn("event_type", 
                       expr("array('login', 'logout', 'api_call', 'data_access', 'error')[cast(rand() * 5 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("priority", 
                       expr("array('P1', 'P2', 'P3', 'P4')[cast(rand() * 4 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("tier", 
                       expr("array('enterprise', 'professional', 'standard', 'free')[cast(rand() * 4 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("response_time_ms", expr("cast(rand() * 2000 as int)"))
            .withColumn("status_code", 
                       expr("array(200, 201, 400, 401, 403, 404, 500, 503)[cast(rand() * 8 as int)]"))
            .withColumn("timestamp", current_timestamp())
        )
        
        # Assign SLA based on tier and priority
        events_with_sla = (events
            .withColumn(
                "sla_seconds",
                when((col("tier") == "enterprise") & (col("priority") == "P1"), lit(5))
                .when((col("tier") == "enterprise") & (col("priority") == "P2"), lit(15))
                .when((col("tier") == "professional") & (col("priority") == "P1"), lit(10))
                .when((col("tier") == "professional") & (col("priority") == "P2"), lit(30))
                .when(col("tier") == "standard", lit(60))
                .otherwise(lit(300))
            )
        )
        
        # Process critical events (P1) with low latency
        critical_events = (events_with_sla
            .filter(col("priority") == "P1")
            .withColumn("alert_time", current_timestamp())
            .select(
                "event_id",
                "tenant_id",
                "user_id",
                "event_type",
                "tier",
                "sla_seconds",
                "timestamp",
                "alert_time"
            )
        )
        
        critical_query = (critical_events
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("critical_events_p1")
            .trigger(processingTime="3 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/multi_tenant_p1")
            .start()
        )
        
        # Process high priority (P2) with moderate latency
        high_priority = (events_with_sla
            .filter(col("priority") == "P2")
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "1 minute")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "15 seconds"),
                "tenant_id",
                "tier"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("event_count"),
                countDistinct("user_id").alias("active_users"),
                avg("response_time_ms").alias("avg_response_time"),
                sum(when(col("status_code") >= 400, 1).otherwise(0)).alias("error_count")
            )
            .withColumn("error_rate", col("error_count") / col("event_count") * 100)
        )
        
        high_priority_query = (high_priority
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("high_priority_p2")
            .trigger(processingTime="15 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/multi_tenant_p2")
            .start()
        )
        
        # Process normal priority (P3, P4) with high throughput
        normal_priority = (events_with_sla
            .filter(col("priority").isin(["P3", "P4"]))
            .withWatermark("timestamp", "5 minutes")
            .groupBy(
                window("timestamp", "1 minute"),
                "tenant_id",
                "tier",
                "event_type"
            )
            .agg(
                count("*").alias("total_events"),
                avg("response_time_ms").alias("avg_response_time"),
                expr("percentile_approx(response_time_ms, 0.95)").alias("p95_response_time")
            )
        )
        
        normal_priority_query = (normal_priority
            .writeStream
            .outputMode("append")
            .format("console")
            .queryName("normal_priority_p3_p4")
            .trigger(processingTime="60 seconds")
            .option("checkpointLocation", "/tmp/multi_tenant_normal")
            .start()
        )
        
        # Monitor all queries
        queries = [critical_query, high_priority_query, normal_priority_query]
        query_manager = StreamingQueryManager(self.spark)
        
        for query in queries:
            query_manager.add_query(query.name, query)
        
        logger.info("Monitoring multi-tenant platform for 90 seconds...")
        
        for i in range(9):
            time.sleep(10)
            query_manager.print_status()
        
        # Stop all queries
        query_manager.stop_all()
        logger.info("Multi-tenant platform example completed")
        
        return queries


# ============================================================================
# FINAL INTEGRATION AND MAIN RUNNER
# ============================================================================

def run_all_complete_examples():
    """
    Run all complete working examples
    """
    # Initialize Spark
    spark = (SparkSession.builder
             .appName("CompleteLatencyPatternExamples")
             .config("spark.sql.streaming.metricsEnabled", "true")
             .config("spark.sql.shuffle.partitions", "100")
             .config("spark.streaming.backpressure.enabled", "true")
             .config("spark.sql.adaptive.enabled", "true")
             .getOrCreate())
    
    spark.sparkContext.setLogLevel("WARN")
    
    try:
        examples = CompleteWorkingExamples(spark)
        
        # Run Example 1: Fraud Detection
        logger.info("\n\n" + "=" * 80)
        logger.info("RUNNING EXAMPLE 1 OF 5")
        logger.info("=" * 80)
        examples.example_1_fraud_detection_low_latency()
        time.sleep(10)
